articles.title: First Atmosphere Detected on a Rocky Planet in the Habitable Zone—A Game Changer for Alien Life Hunt
articles.summary: In a historic first, astronomers detected helium escaping from super-Earth LHS 1140 b, proving it has an atmosphere. Located 48 light-years away in its star’s habitable zone, this rocky world could have conditions suitable for life. The finding, published in Science, opens a new era of exoplanet exploration.

articles.title: 1,300-Year-Old Gold Treasure Unearthed Beneath Thailand’s Ancient Reclining Buddha
articles.summary: While digging a drainage system at Wat Thammachak Sema Ram, workers discovered a ceramic pot containing 33 gold, silver, and bronze ornaments from the Dvaravati period. Additional finds included repoussé metal sheets depicting Buddha, likely ritual offerings. The 43-foot statue dates to 657 A.D.

articles.title: From Ancient China to a $6,696 Scoop: Celebrate National Ice Cream Month with These Wild Facts
articles.summary: National Ice Cream Month, declared by President Reagan in 1984, honors a treat with a rich history. The average American eats 23 pounds annually. World records include a 3,010-pound scoop carved in Wisconsin and a $6,696 gelato in Japan featuring truffles and gold leaf.
